The automation tests use short excerpts of real news articles as fixtures. They are copyrighted, so they are not
published in this public repository. To run tests/test_automation.py, save your own article text files here
(trd_capital_one.txt, trd_first_fund.txt, credaily_fund.txt, costar_interview.txt, covercy_blog.txt - each starting
with a line `URL: https://...`). The test skips itself politely when they are missing.
